source.title: 50 Min Cardio HIIT Workout To Burn Calories - Full Body, At Home, No Equipment

notes: Checked against the video: the warm-up and the first minute by eye (the timer counts down to 60 s, then six 30 s moves), the names by sampling the Next: bar at twelve rests across the whole video, the rest from the timer-based draft read through the new name box. Moves are named only in a black Next: <move> bar top left in the 15 s rest before them (the label bottom left is the section, not the move); work is 45 s and rest 15 s in the cardio part, then 30 s work with shorter rests in the abs part, then stretches. An Oliver's Pro Tip box hides the bar in four places (Deadlift to fly, Front lunge with pause, Reverse plank hold, the last Sitting glute stretch). Sections left out: the video's parts are not named on screen.
